title: Dataset — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. A database of datasets: a directory plus full records of public datasets (links, licenses, schemas) and Signature datasets.
capabilities: Dataset directory: searchable registry of public datasets with publisher, link, license, and access method.
License classification: labels each dataset open, public-domain, permissive, or restricted-review.
Schema records: carries each dataset's field/schema documentation as a full record.
Freshness tracking: records last-verified date and update cadence per dataset.
Signature datasets: original Signature-built datasets with full records and generators.
Access guides: step-by-step download and loading instructions per dataset.
Schema diffing: compares dataset versions field by field.
Join recommendations: suggests which datasets combine well and on which keys.

title: Dataset — Worked example
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. title: Dataset — Safety, limits, and failure modes
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Public datasets are LINKED, never redistributed in bulk; only records about them are stored. Licenses are reported as published by the dataset owner — recheck before use, licenses change. Never harvest or store non-public, paywalled, or restricted personal data.
